messages:
zoe (CS): Quick ask 1 Helios goes live tomorrow morning and they're marked 'at-risk' for renewal. We want a tiny, customer-facing runbook for the first 48h that covers: 1) prefill/warmup checklist, 2) recommended batching by prompt size, 3) streaming quick sanity checks, 4) a 2-question feedback ping that feeds into support. Can someone own a short draft we can send to the customer?
omar (CS): I can put together a 1-page checklist + a plain-text 'run these commands' section. Keep customer language light; include an "Engineer note" for teams. Will need eng to confirm the smoke-test script.
kai (eng-runtime): I'll validate smoke tests. Suggested minimal sequence: A) run 12 quick warmup calls to prime tokenizer + KV cache; B) send 25 short streamed requests spaced ~150ms; C) verify first-stream-chunk latency <1.5s and KV hit rate >80%. Ill provide a curl snippet. Also recommend batching heuristics: short prompts (<120 tokens) -> batch_size 32; medium (~120-512) -> 8-16; long (>512) -> 4-8.
tara (support): Add escalation criteria: error rate >1.5% over 5m OR median gen latency >2s -> open urgent ticket. Feedback webhook creates a ticket automatically. Include support link and what info to include (trace_id, sample prompts).
scheduling-bot: Note: Helios dedicated pool warmup scheduled tonight 23:30 UTC.
omar (CS): Good. I'll keep the customer checklist to 5 bullets and a small checkbox for each item. The feedback ping should be two questions: Q1 "Were responses useful?" (Yes / No). Q2 "If no, short note". Hook posts to https://hooks.redwood.ai/helios-feedback.
kai (eng-runtime): Shareable curl (engineer note):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"warmup","stream":true,"batch_size":8}'
```
Expected quick checks: HTTP 200, first stream chunk <=1500ms, KV hit rate climbs >80% after 12 warmups. If KV hit rate stays low, increase prefill_count to 30 or extend TTL. If chunks are delayed, try non-stream endpoint and capture trace_id.
omar (CS): I'll include a tiny troubleshooting table for customers (symptom -> immediate action -> what we'll do):
- "no chunks": check API key/network, run the curl above, switch to non-stream endpoint, send trace_id.
- "low KV hits": run extra warmups (30), confirm tenant id is stable, or ask CSM to request additional prewarm from infra.
- "high latency": reduce batch_size, check prompt length distribution, verify region routing.
tara (support): We'll monitor webhook tickets under tag "onboard/helios". Add instructions to include example prompt and a screenshot of timing if possible.
mar (CS): (typo) meant to say 'omar' :) Omar, can you post the final 1-pager + plain-text script to the Helios contact and paste into this thread so support and eng can track?
omar (CS): Yep I'll finalize and post to #customer-success and DM the Helios CSM by EOD.
zoe (CS): Thanks all 44D. This will make the first 48h easier and hopefully reduce renewal risk. Kai/Tara: please review the final engineer note before I send.
